estimates: Actual OEM US 2000 brochure and official owner manual metric table inspected. Standard GT-S 6MT with 205/55R15, not optional 16-inch or TRD. 180 mechanical hp at 7600 rpm, 130 lb-ft at 6800 rpm, 2500 lb manual curb and 55 L tank.

Physical gearing is CROSS-MARKET INFERENCE: inspected Australian recognition table corroborated by rounded exact-US secondary values, NOT exact US physical gearbox verification. Published precision retained. No LSD assumption.

2500 lb converted with .45359237 kg/lb; fluid/driver convention unknown, no driver mass adjustment. Official metric height 1305 mm retained despite inconsistent parenthesized 51.8 inches and brochure 51.4 inches; metric tracks 1490/1480 mm retained.

7800 tach redline is SECONDARY evidence, not a fuel-cut claim. Early 8400 ECU fuel cut remains unverified; runtime 8000 cutoff is explicitly estimated. Idle 850, front mass fraction .60, CG .52m, overhang split, steering 15, 27 US mpg, 140 mph/7 sec display and full torque curve/VVTL-i approximation are simulation estimates. Differential 0/0 and handling/brake/shift/launch parameters are estimates. Nominal .30325m tire radius is geometric, loaded rolling radius unknown.
Original individually fitted LHD blank binnacle, shared wheel and upper-opening instruments. Fixed rear camera; surface tire smoke/spray only.
